# 🌹 Rose X Music

### The Ultimate Telegram Voice Chat Music Bot

Rose X Music is a modern, high-performance Telegram Voice Chat Music Bot built for speed, stability and premium streaming quality.

Supporting **YouTube**, **Spotify**, **Apple Music**, **SoundCloud**, **Resso**, **Live Radio**, **M3U8**, **Direct Links** and much more.

Designed using modern Python technologies for communities that demand powerful music streaming.

# 📦 Installation

## 🐧 Linux / VPS

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Techspiders1/Rose_X_Musicbot

cd Rose_X_Musicbot

curl -Ls https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

uv sync --frozen

cp sample.env .env

bash start
```

---

## 🪟 Windows

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Techspiders1/Rose_X_Musicbot

cd Rose_X_Musicbot

irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex

uv sync --frozen

copy sample.env .env

uv run python -m Rose_X_Musicbot
```

---

## 🐳 Docker

```bash
docker build -t rose-x-music .

docker run --env-file .env rose-x-music
```

---

# ⚙ Configuration

Rename

```text
sample.env
```

to

```text
.env
```

Then fill all required variables.

# 📋 Environment Variables

```env
API_ID=

API_HASH=

BOT_TOKEN=

OWNER_ID=

LOGGER_ID=

MONGO_DB_URI=

STRING_SESSION=
```

---

# 🤖 Bot Setup

### ① Create a Bot

Create your bot using **@BotFather**

---

### ② Telegram API

Visit

https://my.telegram.org

Generate

- API_ID
- API_HASH

---

### ③ MongoDB

Create a free MongoDB Atlas database.

Copy

```
MONGO_DB_URI
```

---

### ④ Generate String Session

Generate your assistant account session.

Paste it inside

```env
STRING_SESSION=
```

---

### ⑤ Configure

Rename

```
sample.env
```

↓

```
.env
```

Fill every variable.

---

### ⑥ Start Bot

Linux

```bash
bash start
```

Windows

```powershell
uv run python -m Rose_X_Musicbot
```

---

# 🔐 Security Tips

- Never expose your `.env`
- Never share `BOT_TOKEN`
- Never share `STRING_SESSION`
- Never commit secrets to GitHub
- Use private repositories while testing
- Rotate credentials immediately if leaked

# 🎵 User Commands

| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/play` | Play music from YouTube or supported sources |
| `/vplay` | Play video in voice chat |
| `/cplay` | Channel play |
| `/cvplay` | Channel video play |
| `/pause` | Pause playback |
| `/resume` | Resume playback |
| `/skip` | Skip current song |
| `/stop` | Stop player |
| `/end` | End stream |
| `/queue` | Show current queue |
| `/clearqueue` | Clear queue |
| `/shuffle` | Shuffle queue |
| `/loop` | Loop current track |
| `/seek` | Seek current stream |
| `/speed` | Playback speed |
| `/volume` | Volume control |
| `/lyrics` | Fetch lyrics |
| `/song` | Download audio |
| `/video` | Download video |
| `/playlist` | Playlist manager |
| `/replay` | Replay current track |
| `/ping` | Check bot latency |
| `/alive` | Check bot status |
| `/stats` | Bot statistics |

---

# 👑 Admin Commands

| Command | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/broadcast` | Broadcast message |
| `/tagall` | Mention everyone |
| `/gban` | Global ban |
| `/ungban` | Remove global ban |
| `/blacklistchat` | Blacklist chat |
| `/whitelistchat` | Remove blacklist |
| `/maintenance on` | Enable maintenance |
| `/maintenance off` | Disable maintenance |
| `/restart` | Restart bot |
| `/update` | Update bot |
| `/logs` | Download logs |
| `/clean` | Clean cache |
| `/authorize` | Authorize user |
| `/unauthorize` | Remove authorization |
| `/addsudo` | Add sudo user |
| `/delsudo` | Remove sudo user |
